meta.note: Origin and first consumer of the system. The tokens are general-purpose; nothing here is tied to one screen.

color.note: One theme only: the console is always lit colour on black glass. Token names match luna-monitor's Tailwind v4 @theme block, so --color-lcars-orange here is bg-lcars-orange / text-lcars-orange there.

tokens.name: color-lcars-ground
tokens.usage: The only background. Everything else is lit shapes or text on it; also the cut-out inside an elbow.

tokens.name: color-lcars-ink
tokens.usage: Text on every coloured shape (nav buttons, pills, tiles, elbow labels). Never coloured text on a coloured shape.

tokens.name: color-lcars-orange
tokens.usage: Primary identity colour. Clock, page title, readout values, lit segments, the selected option. 10.1:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-cream
tokens.usage: Active nav button and secondary values (device name, notice detail). 16:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-lavender
tokens.usage: Upper elbow, control pills, field labels above a readout. 9.2:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-mauve
tokens.usage: Frame bar segments and a nav slot colour. 9:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-peach
tokens.usage: Nav slot colour, the end-cap pill of a control row (mute), harmless command tiles. 11.7:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-red
tokens.usage: Lower elbow, destructive tiles, segments past the danger threshold, offline status, muted value. 6:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-online
tokens.usage: Status only: the dot and word for a device reported online. Never decorative.

tokens.name: color-lcars-armed
tokens.usage: Status only: a command tile waiting for its confirming second tap, the red-alert title and the far end of the red-alert pulse. 6.8:1 on ground.

tokens.name: color-lcars-inactive
tokens.usage: Unselected option pill. Flag: luna-monitor puts black text on it (2.7:1, below 4.5:1); the Option component uses cream text instead (6:1).

tokens.name: color-lcars-muted
tokens.usage: Lit segments while the channel is muted: present but dimmed. A fill only, never behind text (1.9:1 with ink).

tokens.name: color-lcars-empty
tokens.usage: Unlit segments of a segment bar.

tokens.name: color-lcars-divider
tokens.usage: The one hairline: 2px rule above a status line. No other borders exist.

styles.name: lc-clock
styles.usage: Header clock, orange. Digits are zero-padded.

styles.name: lc-title
styles.usage: Page title, right-aligned in the header, orange.

styles.name: lc-readout
styles.usage: A value: three digits, zero-padded. Also alert headlines.

styles.name: lc-nav
styles.usage: Nav button and option pill label.

styles.name: lc-label
styles.usage: Field label above a readout or bar, lavender.

styles.name: lc-status
styles.usage: Status line at the foot of a page.

styles.name: lc-elbow
styles.usage: Label set inside an elbow, ink, right-aligned.

styles.name: lc-code
styles.usage: Tile code, top-left of a command tile: NN-XXX.

spacing.note: 4px base. Gaps only; no margins between siblings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between bar segments, frame bars and stacked nav buttons.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Between the date and status lines in the header.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills in a control row and between command tiles.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Vertical stack inside a column: label row, bar, controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a nav button.

tokens.name: space-4-5
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a control pill.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a command tile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gutter between the two content columns.

radius.note: Every curve is either an elbow or half the height of the thing it rounds. Pills round only their outer ends; the inner ends of a row stay square.

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Bar segments. The only near-square corner.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot (12px circle).

tokens.name: radius-elbow-inner
tokens.usage: Inner (cut-out) curve of an elbow.

tokens.name: radius-option
tokens.usage: Full pill for a 58px option button.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: End caps of a 64px control row: left cap 32px 0 0 32px, right cap 0 32px 32px 0.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Outer corner of a command tile that sits at a grid corner.

tokens.name: radius-elbow
tokens.usage: Outer curve of an elbow.

layout.note: Frame and component geometry. The frame (Panel) fills its container at any size; content grids reflow on their own. Breakpoints are container widths and are written as literals in @container/@media rules, since CSS variables cannot be used there.

tokens.name: breakpoint-compact
tokens.usage: Below this width the frame turns compact: narrower rail, smaller clock and title, title on its own row.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar rail: elbow vertical arm and nav buttons.

tokens.name: elbow-width
tokens.usage: Elbow incl. the curve into the bar.

tokens.name: rail-width-compact
tokens.usage: Rail width of the compact frame.

tokens.name: elbow-width-compact
tokens.usage: Elbow width of the compact frame.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Horizontal frame bar.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Nav button height.

tokens.name: option-height
tokens.usage: Option pill height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Control row height.

tokens.name: segmentbar-height
tokens.usage: Segment bar height (25 segments).

tokens.name: tile-height
tokens.usage: Command tile height (3 x 2 grid).
